content.name: Nikhil Malhotra
content.title: Head of Talent Acquisition
content.summary: Talent acquisition leader with 16 years across RPO, IT services and fintech. Heads a 22-member TA team hiring about 2,500 people a year for a digital lending company, and cut cost per hire by 34% while halving dependence on recruitment agencies.

experience.title: Head of Talent Acquisition
bullets: Lead a 22-member team hiring about 2,500 people a year across tech, collections and sales for a digital lending company.
Reduced agency share of hires from 55% to 24% and cost per hire by 34% through referrals and in-house sourcing.
Set up hiring hubs in Jaipur and Indore that filled 900 collections roles in tier-2 cities.
Introduced a hiring-manager scorecard and monthly business reviews with each function head.
Own an annual TA budget of ₹9 crore including tools, job boards and campus events.

experience.title: Talent Acquisition Lead
bullets: Led a team of 12 recruiters handling lateral hiring for cloud and testing practices, about 1,200 hires a year.
Ran campus hiring at 40 engineering colleges, onboarding 600 freshers a year.
Brought offer-to-joining drop-offs down from 32% to 17% with pre-joining engagement calls.

experience.title: Senior Recruiter
bullets: Managed delivery for two global banking clients' Indian operations hiring.
Filled 25 to 30 positions a month for analytics and operations roles.
Trained 15 junior recruiters on sourcing on Naukri and client documentation.

experience.title: Recruitment Executive
bullets: Screened and scheduled candidates for BPO and customer support roles.
Conducted walk-in drives that processed up to 300 candidates a day.
Maintained candidate trackers and daily MIS for account managers.

achievements.title: Cost per hire down 34%
achievements.detail: In-house sourcing and referrals at Kosh Fintech.

achievements.title: Joining drop-off 32% to 17%
achievements.detail: Pre-joining engagement at Aravalli Tech Services.
